inbox.name: Idea Labs Explorer
inbox.tagline: A single-file interactive dashboard that turns 242 screenshots into a searchable, cross-linked intelligence hub.
inbox.description: Offline-capable explorer built from the idea labs image drop. Pipeline: every image OCR'd with Tesseract, compressed to embedded base64 thumbnails, then analyst-verified. Frontend is one self-contained HTML file (no dependencies): tabbed interface with global search across names, URLs, prompts, and transcriptions; sortable/filterable card grid of 314 unique websites with outbound links; 9 copy-to-clipboard script/prompt packs; 136 summary cards where each card shows its screenshot, the items listed in it (hyperlinked), and a written-out transcription. Unified sitewide card design system; covers 242/242 images.
inbox.stack: Python 3, Pillow, Tesseract OCR, Vanilla JavaScript, Inline CSS, JSON, Single-file HTML
inbox.differentiator: Zero-dependency single-file app that works inside network-isolated sandboxes; every image is both OCR-transcribed and human-analyst verified; reverse index links each website to the exact screenshots it appeared in, and each image back to the items it lists — no other view of this archive exists.
